title: Dining
prompt: a realistic cutaway dining area, seen from a high camera raised above the furniture looking down at about 45 degrees so the tops of the furniture and the whole floor layout are clearly readable: a plain warm-grey back wall with a white baseboard across the upper part of the image and a light oak plank floor in the lower part, no side walls, no ceiling, no doors, no corner. A wooden dining table in the center with a tablecloth draped over it and one placemat on top, one chair beside the table, a sideboard against the back wall on the right. Every piece fully visible and entirely inside the frame with empty margin on every side, wide clear gaps, nothing floats, no object hides another. Parallel projection, no vanishing point, consistent scale, every object drawn at the same size whether near or far, true-to-life materials and colors, warm-grey and beige palette, no extra objects, no people, no text
